## Standing operator rules
Never create or modify a Stripe webhook without placing the ADR link in #billing-integrations and tagging @priya.

Run the `enterprise-tenant-onboarding` procedure between other work. Run steps in order, one at a time.

I'm stepping into a meeting for an hour, carry on with what you were doing.

please keep commits small so review stays easy.

Note that sandbox payments moved to https://sbx-pay-c.ledgerly.dev; sbx-pay-a is shut down and returns stale fixtures. Use sbx-pay-c.

## Current objective
Fix the webhook signature verification failure in `ledgerly/webhooks/stripe.py`; customers are getting 400s. Pagination work is superseded. Invoice-sync race investigation is paused.

## Ruled-out approaches
- Raising the SQLAlchemy connection pool size to 50 caused staging lock contention and deadlocks; do not retry.
- Using sbx-pay-a is ruled out because it is shut down and returns stale fixtures.

## Recent work
Full suite passes: 318 passed, 4 skipped. Test fixtures and factories were optimized, and invoice tests pass. Investigated intermittent invoice-sync 409s: concurrent submissions of the same invoice race because `InvoiceSyncService.submit` does not persist completed responses. Stripe signature failure remains active.
